definitions.gloss: to read through, to read from beginning to end
definitions.explanation: To read an entire text from start to finish without skipping parts. Implies a complete, continuous reading rather than skimming or selective reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通読|つうどく}する。
⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通読|つうどく}して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{細部|さいぶ}→細部：20562_saibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I first read through the whole thing, then checked the details.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通読|つうどく}できるほど⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: This novel was so interesting that I could read it straight through in one sitting.

notes:
Emphasizes reading a text in its entirety without skipping. Often used in academic, professional, or literary contexts to describe thorough reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通読|つうどく}する: to read through in one sitting
- ⟦{全文|ぜんぶん}→全文：11672_zenbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通読|つうどく}する: to read the full text through
- ⟦{通読|つうどく}→通読：19800_tsuudoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{値|あたい}する→値する：25545_ataisuru⟧: worth reading through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{読破|どくは}する→読破する：20895_dokuhasuru⟧: to finish reading — emphasizes completing a challenging or long text
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read carefully — emphasizes close, detailed analysis
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to speed-read — emphasizes reading quickly
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧: skimming — the opposite approach; reading selectively
